content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total, one for each post. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the two posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The experience for both posts is printed as "preferably", so it is a preference rather than a fixed requirement. Only citizens of Meghalaya are invited to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post. The notice does not mention the date on which age is counted, and it prints no minimum age.

rows.qualification: BAMS Degree from a recognised Institute. Registered with Meghalaya council for Indian system of Medicine.
Minimum Qualification: Bachelor in Naturopathy and Yogic science (BNYS) from a recognized University.
rows.experience: Preferably with one year and above working experience

rows.relaxation: 5 years (As per OM No. PER 38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both posts are filled on a contractual basis for a period of 11 months. The contract is renewable upon satisfactory performance. For the AYUSH Medical Officer cum CHO, Rs. 15,000 of the Rs. 40,000 is Performance Linked Payment (PLP).

rows.fixed_remuneration: Rs. 40000/- per month (Rs. 25000/- per month as a fixed remuneration and Rs. 15000/- per month as Performance Linked Payment (PLP))

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The District AYUSH Society will screen all applications, then hold either a written test or a direct walk-in interview depending on the number of candidates. Screening: All applications are subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. An application found incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected. Written test: Held for the posts if the number of candidates is more than 30. Direct walk-in interview: Held if the number of candidates is less than 30. Personal interview: The personal interview of the successful candidates will be intimated after the written test. No separate call letter or any other form of communication will be issued to candidates about the written test or walk-in interview. The dates of the written test and the interview are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Ri-Bhoi District AYUSH Society Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted in hard copy. The notice prints no application form format. Prepare the application for the post you are applying for. Enclose all relevant certificates, testimonials, etc with the application. Submit it to the Office of the District AYUSH Society (Homoeopathic OPD), Civil Hospital Nongpoh. Submit between 18/11/2026 and 30/11/2026, up to 4 PM, on working days only. No application will be accepted after the mentioned date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: All relevant certificates, enclosed with the application Testimonials, enclosed with the application ID card (EPIC, AADHAR, Driving Licence etc.), to be produced at the written test

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Ri-Bhoi District AYUSH Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Medical Officer cum CHO and 1 Yoga Professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Hard-copy applications are accepted from 18 November 2026 to 30 November 2026 up to 4 PM, on working days only.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for AYUSH Medical Officer cum CHO?
faq.answer: A BAMS Degree from a recognised Institute and registration with the Meghalaya council for Indian system of Medicine, preferably with 2 years working experience.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Yoga Professionals?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a Bachelor in Naturopathy and Yogic science (BNYS) from a recognized University, preferably with one year and above working experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for both posts, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST as per OM No. PER 38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: AYUSH Medical Officer cum CHO gets Rs. 40,000 per month (Rs. 25,000 fixed plus Rs. 15,000 Performance Linked Payment), and Yoga Professionals gets Rs. 28,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: In hard copy, at the Office of the District AYUSH Society (Homoeopathic OPD), Civil Hospital Nongpoh, with all relevant certificates and testimonials enclosed.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: A written test will be held if there are more than 30 candidates; if there are fewer than 30, a direct walk-in interview will be held after screening.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, both posts are on a contractual basis for 11 months, renewable upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only eligible candidates who are citizens of Meghalaya can apply.
